title: Passover — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: Passover commemorates the Exodus from Egypt with the Seder meal, unleavened bread called matzah, and the retelling of liberation. It is one of the most widely observed Jewish holidays. This overview edition presents Passover within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
